challenges.text: open Procreate and make exactly ONE mark. that's it. you're done. ✏️
set a 2-minute timer and sketch whatever is in front of you. no good, no bad.
write the name of ONE design idea in your notes app. just the name. done.
pick one WIP. finish it ugly. export it. done counts. 🌸
set a timer for 25 minutes. work on ONE thing only. when it ends, it's done.
open your sketchbook. put it on your desk. that's it. habit = going. ✨
post ONE story today. a photo of your desk, your drink, anything. it counts.
screenshot one piece of your art and send it to one person who'd love it. 🌸
write 2 sentences: one thing you made that you're proud of + why it matters.

recoveryQuests: write a 3-sentence reflection about what got in the way. no judgment, just honesty.
post one story to any platform — your mug, your desk, a doodle.
spend 10 minutes on any design task. even just opening your tools counts.
answer this: what's one small thing i can protect time for tomorrow?
